description.narrative: This Initiation Plan is designed as a bridge between the current UNDP Strategic Plan (2022–2025) and the new Strategic Plan (2026–2029), ensuring continuity while positioning inclusive growth at the forefront of the next cycle. The new Strategic Plan is built around four objectives: 1) prosperity for all; 2) effective governance; 3) crisis resilience; and 4) a healthy planet, powered by three accelerators: digital and AI transformation, gender equality, and sustainable finance. Inclusive growth is central to this vision, serving as a key pathway for advancing prosperity while intersecting with governance, resilience, and planetary sustainability.The Plan responds to country demand for integrated solutions that create jobs and livelihoods, expand and modernize social protection, unlock the potential of MSMEs and value chains, strengthen local and urban economies, and harness trade and migration for inclusive development. It also reflects with UNDP’s evolving portfolio and systems approach, which emphasizes tackling interconnected challenges in ways that catalyze structural transformation rather than isolated interventions.In this context, the Initiation Plan will consolidate existing workstreams on poverty and inequality reduction and broaden them to encompass the transitions shaping the future of economies and societies, including green and digital transformations, care and demographic shifts, and the growing pressures of climate change and migration. Its flexible framing is deliberately broad, allowing UNDP to engage with a wide range of partners and respond dynamically to emerging priorities and financing opportunities.
